statement.text:
Given a smooth knot $K \subset S^{3}$, determine its nonorientable 4-
genus $\gamma_{4}$, i.e. the minimal first Betti number for all compact nonorientable smooth
surfaces $F$ properly embedded in $B^{4}$ with boundary $K$. This question may be devel-
oped in several directions:
(1) (Allen’s Geography Question [All23]) For a given knot $K \subset S^{3}$, find
the pairs $(e, b) \in \mathbb{Z}^{2}$ realized by the normal Euler number and first Betti
number of a nonorientable bounding surface $F$.
(2) By analogy with the Milnor Conjecture for the orientable 4-genus of torus
knots, what is the nonorientable 4-genus of a torus knot $T_{p,q}$?
